Subject: Forecast ambassador: final prep & staggered submission agenda

Team —

One quick, high-impact ask this morning as we enter the submission window: please treat your commit rows as the single source for final numbers. We’re running a staggered submission this week (owners in A–M submit at 12:00, N–Z at 16:00 PT) to smooth the intake.

What I need from each owner by their window:
- A single commit row in the shared Q2_forecast_template.xlsx (attached).
- A short comment in the Commit Notes column if there was a stage change, product caveat, or credit consideration.
- If you’re the designated ambassador for a peer (see owner-ambassador-roster.csv), please confirm their row and mark “AMB” in the Approver column.

Quick agenda for today’s standup (12:30 PT, 15 mins) — join if you have active late-stage motion or evidence to flag:
1) Quick status by owner (30s each)
2) Any deal >$50k with stage ambiguity — raise for triage
3) Evidence handoff and attachments checklist

Attachments: Q2_forecast_template.xlsx, owner-ambassador-roster.csv.

If an external finance ask arrives (Acme or other big accounts), loop in me & Marcus immediately so we can route through Procurement.

Thanks — concise and tactical please.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses. Final notes before close:

- Stage mapping: Use this simple rule set for today (I'll follow up with a formal doc):
  • Negotiation = commercial terms in flight, no signed SOW/PO;
  • Legal review = contract language or data terms being negotiated (counts as Commit if sales has verbal commitment AND Legal is the only outstanding item);
  • Ambiguous-stage = flag as Ambiguous-stage and add notes; Finance will not auto-accept ambiguous rows.

- Sign-off: For deals > $100k, ambassadors must add name + timestamp in the Approver column. For <$100k, a Commit Notes comment is sufficient.

- Evidence: a single PDF per deal (pricing + key email thread) is preferred. Put files in the shared folder and reference file name in the Evidence column.

I started the standup notes (link below) and will upload the consolidated spreadsheet after the last submission window closes. If ACME needs earlier confirmation, Sarah — I can do a handoff call at 17:00 PT; Marcus will cover procurement follow-through tomorrow.

Standup notes (live): https://redwood.app/docs/forecast-template-2027
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=forecast-ambassador-standup-20270523

Irene
